_about: Beaucy, Valentine (141147, heavenly_two_vt23): translated from the game's Japanese. Global terms: 'Cowdy' (her catchphrase ビーフ), Cacow, the BRASS (コルルル), Cosmic, Chateaubrilliand, the Oculus, Noenne, Nova, Pur Lilie, Mary (sheep_girl), Nate, Reticia, Mr. Producer, Valentine's Fest, Starview Village.
profile: A gravure-type top idol who conquered the Cosmic Battle Idol Royale--better known as the BRASS--a proxy war waged by twelve mysterious nations staking their prestige on the outcome. Her immense Cosmic power and love for idols don't fade one bit even off-shot. Her catchphrase is "Cowdy."
titleCondition: Level Beaucy to 100 and obtain her Amity Scroll

speech.home/bifu_watashini: Cowdy. To me, people's gazes are an honor...! ...However. Heh... Every now and then, an outfit for going incognito is fun too.
speech.home/fuesudewa: At the Fest, I received all kinds of presents from my fans too. As a gravure idol, I will live up to their expectations. ...And someday, as a regular idol too. Without fail.
speech.home/kakau_itsumo: Cacow. Thank you for everything, as always. This chocolate is for you. Yes. Please enjoy it with some brandy.
speech.home/koibanawa: ...! Love talk is...! N-No. It's no problem if it's about other people. It's just, when it comes to me... Uuugh...!!
speech.home/omoio: A festival for conveying your feelings... How lovely. I, too, shall speak to my heart's content about my love for idols.
speech.home/shibuyano: I'll spare no effort helping rebuild Shibuya. ...I wonder what kinds of idols I'll meet in that city. I'm already looking forward to it.
speech.ally/join: Cowdy. Since it's Valentine's Fest, why don't we go look around together, in secret? ...Heh. Just kidding.
speech.ally/evolution: Here, please. Take this. It's chocolate I made myself. ...Keep it a secret from everyone, okay? ...It's special, after all. Cowdy...

1.title: Valentine Off-Shot
1.summary: To keep a mini concert from being canceled after a mix-up in booking idols, Beaucy hands the staff her top-secret files. Then she steps on stage herself to buy time. It couldn't be called a success, but she's happy to have taken a step forward.

lines.9: Beaucy, camera at ten o'clock! Give it a look!!
lines.21: Gooood!! Great work, Beaucy~! Another perfect shoot today~!!
lines.24: Amazing... So this is how they shoot the gravure for the Oculus.
lines.33: No... I think this is a pretty special case...!?
lines.42: Hey, we just came to watch. Our job was nearby.
lines.46: Shooting even during Valentine's Fest... Being a gravure idol must be tough, huh?
lines.51: This time, the concept was an off-shot at the Fest--a secret date on my day off.
lines.56: ...I see? It looks casual, but the styling is flawless. It's a concept that really gets the feeling across. Sneaky...!
lines.72: What's wrong? Is there some kind of trouble?
lines.75: Ah, no! It's not this shoot, but the mini concert being held in the square after this is a bit...
lines.77: Apparently there was a mistake booking some of the idols... There's talk that the concert itself might get canceled.
lines.79: It's a shame... but it can't be helped. Well, it's a small stage, so the damage won't be that--
lines.82: That won't do...! The people who were looking forward to it will be sad.
lines.89: B-But even if we look for substitute idols, it sounds like everyone's schedule is packed this time of year--
lines.93: Cowdy...! In that case, I shall lend you my aid.
lines.97: That is a list of promising newcomers and underground idols I keep tabs on regularly.
lines.101: Those girls might rush over, seeing this as the perfect opportunity. ...Though overdoing it is never good.
lines.107: There's no need for thanks. However, that list is top-secret material. Never show it to anyone but the staff.
lines.110: We'll keep helping the staff. Well then, see you later--
lines.118: If we're splitting up to negotiate appearances, the more people the better, right? Don't worry, I've got a little experience.
lines.134: Cowdy...! How did your negotiations go?
lines.138: It's fine. Looks like all the planned slots got filled.
lines.142: ...But they might be late getting on stage. They're rushing over, but--
lines.152: Beaucy...! Don't tell me you're going to...!?
lines.155: Thank youuu for that lovely love song!! Now! Up next is... Huh? They're not here yet? Um...!
lines.158: --The next idol to sing is me.
lines.162: Hey, Alk. Beaucy's a gravure idol--can she even do concerts?
lines.166: I don't know. --But we've seen it. We've seen how hard she's worked...!
lines.172: Cowdy. I'm proud of who I am as a gravure idol.
lines.175: However, today. Here. I will take on my old dream once more.
lines.179: Let's do this, Beaucy. Regular idol and gravure idol. To claim both crowns--!!
lines.198: Th-This won't keep the audience engaged...!
lines.202: She tried...! She really did try...!!
lines.205: Wh-What are we being shown here...!? Wait, is it so bad it's good...!?
lines.217: D-Did we... make it in time...?
lines.226: Leave the rest to Noenne and friends! --Knockin' Heart Miracle! On fire!!
lines.233: Well... We somehow got through it in one piece~
lines.237: Cowdy. This is all thanks to the staff and you all.
lines.240: ...But it hit me hard. I'm still far from being an idol who can sing and dance.
lines.245: Really? Sure, it might not have been a success, but--
lines.249: No. When it comes to judging idols, I know better than anyone.
lines.252: But even so-- I'm happy that I was able to take a step forward.
lines.255: For now, I'll keep training steadily without rushing.
lines.259: ...I see. So that's how you are, Beaucy.
lines.264: Cowdy. More importantly. Right now, let's enjoy the concert.
lines.269: They're members you like enough to put on your favorites list, after all~
lines.273: I believe I said that was top secret?
lines.281: Cowdy. As long as you understand.
lines.290: ...Heh. This year looks like it'll be a wonderful Valentine's Fest too.

2.title: A New Stage
2.summary: As part of her fan activities, Beaucy asks Alk to teach her how to make chocolate so she can give shape to her love for idols. Along the way it comes out that she's terrible with love talk, but she finishes the chocolate. Satisfied that she gave shape to her love, she shares it with everyone.

lines.5: --My fan activities are entering a new stage.
lines.9: I'd like to aim even higher, and I was hoping you could help me.
lines.13: ...Um. So you're starting some new kind of fan activity...?
lines.17: Cowdy. Specifically, I'm thinking of making homemade chocolate. Would you teach me?
lines.21: I see! In that case, I'd be glad to!
lines.24: Have you decided what kind of chocolate you want to make?
lines.28: Let me see... It's only a rough image, but--
lines.31: I'd like to fully recreate the event hall known as the holy land of idols at one-tenth scale.
lines.39: About a hundred sets of it.
lines.53: Well... I get how you feel, but there's no way a beginner can make chocolate that amazing...?
lines.56: And the amount too, a hundred...? Hmm...
lines.59: ...Well... if it's ordinary chocolate... we could... manage? Maybe???
lines.68: Wait...! But it's probably going to be really tough...!?
lines.72: Cowdy. Even so. I'm sorry for the trouble, Alk, but--
lines.75: --I want to give shape to my love for idols.
lines.86: --With this much, just gathering the ingredients is a job in itself.
lines.90: Cowdy. Sorry for the trouble. Even having you come shopping with me.
lines.94: Hey, I'm looking forward to making a ton too. Besides, I need to buy stuff for dinner--
lines.103: Ah. No... People are kind of staring...
lines.106: Hey, isn't that Beaucy? She's got the cow with her...! Whoa, no way, it's really her...!!
lines.108: She's got such an amazing figure...! I'm so jealous...!
lines.111: Cowdy. Once you get used to it, it doesn't bother you much. You've had a lot going on lately too, haven't you, Alk?
lines.115: Yeah... People recognize me a lot more because of the Shibuya stuff. ...But it looks like I'm still a long way from getting used to it.
lines.118: U-Um! You're Beaucy, right!? I'm a fan, please sign this...!!
lines.121: Cowdy. Thank you for always supporting me.
lines.127: Nope, it's not. I'm just playing manager, so don't worry!
lines.131: ...Alk isn't that kind of person to me. He's a precious comrade.
lines.134: O-Of course! Sorry for saying something weird! Thank you for the autograph!
lines.137: Well... I didn't expect people to see us that way...
lines.150: Forgive me, Alk. The truth is, Beaucy is terrible when the topic turns to love.
lines.161: N-No way...!? Dropping that info right now is way too calculated...!?
lines.166: D-Don't be fooled. Love is a piece of cake for me. I'm always dreaming of wonderful love stories...!
lines.182: Ah, Beaucy! No club today? Then let's walk home together for once!
lines.186: Cowdy. We mustn't. What if someone sees us?
lines.193: Aww. We're childhood friends, so it's not weird.
lines.196: Or... should we just tell everyone we're dating?
lines.202: That's totally just a fantasy!!!! And a middle-school boy's one at that!!!!
lines.208: Dammit, what is this...! The secondhand embarrassment is unreal...!!
lines.212: Do you understand now? Just how hopeless Beaucy is at love...
lines.222: W-Well... I can tell how much you love idols, at least...
lines.227: P-Please don't tell anyone about this...! I beg you... I beg you...
lines.234: Finally, dust it with cocoa powder--
lines.242: Great work! Wow, you worked so hard!
lines.246: Cowdy. You too, Alk. Thank you so much.
lines.252: Well then, shall we call everyone over and eat it?
lines.256: Huh!? But... Aren't you giving it to the idols?
lines.265: Many agencies prohibit gifts of food--especially homemade ones.
lines.269: Ahh...? Right. That's right. Of course.
lines.274: But there's meaning in giving shape to love. Isn't there?
lines.282: In that case, let's all dig in!

3.title: Love Spreads
3.summary: After helping crack down on illegal chocolate counterfeiters, Beaucy and the others buy counterfeit chocolate at a stall on the way home and use it to track down the counterfeiters' base. Having solved the case through her love for idols, Beaucy heads out on yet another trip to support her favorite idols today.

lines.5: Stop your pointless resistance. It's in your best interest to come quietly.
lines.8: Gwuuh...!? You've been hitting us with weird attacks this whole time...! What the hell are you!!
lines.11: Cowdy. A gravure idol enjoying her day off.
lines.14: That makes no sense!! Damn it!
lines.18: You won't get away! Cosmic Gravure Power!!
lines.25: Everyone! Thank you so much for helping us bust those illegal traders★
lines.29: Now then, Mr. Cuddle. Here are the confiscated goods. Could you check them, just to be sure?
lines.32: ...No doubt about it. This isn't chocolate from my shop, Cuddle Sweets. It's a fake.
lines.35: So they were passing off cheap chocolate as a popular shop's and selling it? What a petty move.
lines.39: It must be the influence of the confession boom at the Fest in recent years and the appearance of Shibuya increasing the demand for chocolate.
lines.44: The Guild keeps watch in all sorts of ways, but it's still hard to stop it completely...
lines.47: ...You see, I've been making sweets ever since Palpebra was just a group of small caravans.
lines.49: Eating something sweet can make you a little bit happier. I've always believed that...
lines.52: Having something precious to you used in a way you never wanted... I understand how you must feel.
lines.60: The people we caught today are just the bottom rung of the counterfeiters, right? We need to take down the ringleader fast...!
lines.65: We haven't pinpointed their base yet, but we're still investigating. If there's any progress, I'll let you know.
lines.69: Cowdy. Please take this, if you'd like. It's my list of top recommended idols.
lines.72: Just like sweets, consuming idols can make you happy too.
lines.75: ...Please don't let this get you down too much.
lines.78: Hahaha... Thank you, young lady. I'll accept the thought, at least...
lines.83: Leads on the counterfeiters, huh... We probably don't have much time left, right?
lines.87: Indeed. Once the Fest ends, the merchandise will change. The investigation will likely stall after that.
lines.92: We must find a lead as soon as possible--
lines.95: Fresh stock! Fresh stock just in!! A collab chocolate between the popular shop Cuddle Sweets and charismatic adventurer Levy!!
lines.97: Quantities are limited, so get yours while you caaan!!
lines.100: Cowdy. My apologies. I bought it on reflex.
lines.104: N-No, it's fine. I'm glad you managed to get one.
lines.109: So Levy's in your range too...
lines.115: What? Did you panic and buy the wrong thing?
lines.124: No doubt about it. This chocolate is a counterfeit product...!!
lines.129: Hey! You got rid of anything that could be traced back to us, right? Forget that junk chocolate!
lines.131: Heh heh heh, the Fest made us a killing. Let's get out of here before anything goes wrong!!
lines.138: I see. So this is the counterfeiters' base.
lines.141: Wha...!? Are you hired by the Guild!? How did you find this place...!
lines.144: Cowdy. How? ...If anything, it was only natural.
lines.148: For an idol fan, figuring out the production route from a merch item's materials and coloring is child's play...!!
lines.151: You meant this as one last big score, but using idols was a mistake.
lines.155: Tch, what are you babbling about! You lot! Don't let them leave here alive!!
lines.159: Cowdy. Do you really think you can beat me, a gravure-type idol, in close combat?
lines.162: That blow was my anger at you for using idols in your crimes.
lines.168: This is the anger of Lady Levy, who was turned into merchandise without permission!!
lines.174: This is the anger of the consumers stuck with fakes!!
lines.179: This is the anger of Alk and the others!!
lines.188: And this-- --is the anger of the old man!!!
lines.198: I heard from the Guild. You young folks solved everything. Thank you so, so much...!
lines.201: There's no need for thanks. As a kindred spirit who holds something precious in her heart, I only did what was natural.
lines.204: Chocolate and idols alike. Both make people happy.
lines.207: ...I see. I don't really understand idols, but... I'm sure they're something wonderful.
lines.210: Cowdy. If you say so, then nothing could make me happier.
lines.215: --So, Mary? What's with asking for advice all of a sudden? Did you have a fight with your boyfriend?
lines.222: Lately, my grandpa seems to have gotten hooked on idols, see? He goes to concerts and handshake events every week--
lines.226: His chants and glow stick moves are razor sharp, and he even buys merch for the whole family. H-How should I react...?
lines.231: H-He's a lively grandpa, isn't he. Well, maybe you should just watch over him? Age doesn't matter when it comes to hobbies, so let him--
lines.235: Hey, Beaucy. Heading out on another trip today?

1141147/1.19:
A gravure-type top idol who conquered the Cosmic Battle Idol Royale--better known as the BRASS--a proxy war waged by twelve mysterious nations staking their prestige on the outcome.

Her immense Cosmic power and love for idols don't fade one bit even off-shot. Her catchphrase is "Cowdy."

5000617/1.19:
A list of the idols Beaucy supports.

All idols are equally precious, but since time and money are finite, it's the bitter fruit of tearfully ranking them by priority.

Considering the possibility that interference from being observed could shake the very nature of the idols on it, Beaucy keeps this list top secret.

5000618/1.19:
A popular sweets shop in Palpebra. It's also a long-established shop that has been around since Palpebra was a caravan.

Its founder, Cuddle, handed the shop down to his son and daughter-in-law, and now devotes himself to supporting the business and passing his skills on to his granddaughter.

5000618/2.19:
For a time, it was plagued by brand counterfeiters, but the problem was brilliantly solved thanks to the efforts of a certain gravure idol.

Rumor has it that, following the incident, a "BRASS x Cuddle Sweets" collab dessert is in the works.

5000618/3.19:
Its delicious treats have become known in Starview Village too.

A sweet-toothed mage and a fierce desert general can often be seen buying from it for a tasty sugar boost, and a well-informed fox yokai princess who read the magazine feature often gathers the town's sweets lovers for tasting parties of new flavors.
